title: Cover
description: Meraki brand cover with terracotta panel and investor presentation header.

title: The Problem
description: Three pain points: no reliable channel, quality uncertainty, workers left behind.

title: Our Solution
description: Meraki platform: cleaning, laundry, and combined packages. Book vetted workers in minutes.

title: Market Opportunity
description: 5M+ Addis Ababa population, 500K+ domestic workers, $2B+ informal market.

title: Business Model
description: Two revenue streams: household subscriptions + 20% per-booking commission.

title: Social Impact
description: Fair pay, formal employment status, and skills growth for domestic workers.

title: Traction & Roadmap
description: 320 waitlist households, 48 workers, 4.7 rating, 88% repeat rate. Roadmap to Series A.

title: Team
description: Three co-founders: CEO (operations), CTO (engineering), COO (social enterprise). Advisors.

title: The Ask
description: $500K seed round: worker training 40%, product 30%, marketing 20%, ops 10%.
